note: ShulkerBoxTooltip 4.0.4 was converted by CenturyBridge; BlockEntityPreviewProvider still reads ItemStack.getSubNbt("BlockEntityTag") (t0) and ItemStack.fromNbt(...) (t1), both tombstones. 1.21.1 keeps the same item list under the CONTAINER component (class_9334.field_49622). The bridge renders the component back into the old Items compound and parses item compounds back into stacks.

methodRedirects.evidence: Expansion report: BlockEntityPreviewProvider.getInventory hit 'CenturyBridge tombstone: class_1799.method_7941 no longer exists in 1.21.1' (runs/p88-mod-expansion/EXPANSION-REPORT.md). The preview needs the Items list; the bridge rebuilds it from CONTAINER.
Same provider converts each Items entry through the 1.20.x ItemStack.fromNbt(NbtCompound), which is also a tombstone on 1.21.1. Items without a tag round-trip by id + Count.

The C2S handshake calls C2SChannel.sendToServer -> old ClientPlayNetworkHandler.sendPacket(Packet) (class_634.method_2883), tombstoned on 1.21.1; in the combined smoke run this threw 'class_634.method_2883 no longer exists' (runs/p96-combined-smoke/). The bridge forwards to handler.getConnection().send(packet).

S2CEnderChestUpdate.create called the 1.20.1 EnderChestInventory.writeNbt(); 1.21.1 requires RegistryOps, so the integrated server crashed with NoSuchMethodError (runs/p96-combined-smoke/). The bridge serialises slots as Slot/id/Count, the same shape the mod's client reader expects.

The client handler calls the single-argument EnderChestInventory.readNbt(NbtList) (1.21.1 added RegistryOps), which would throw NoSuchMethodError on receipt. The bridge restores the Slot/id/Count items.

BlockEntityPreviewProvider.getInventory guards with nbt.contains("Items", 9); 1.21.1 tests the element type there, so the legacy check is always false and the preview inventory stays empty (observed with a server-given shulker box, runs/p110-shulker-grid/). The bridge keeps the old 'is a list' meaning for type 9.
